metadata.title: 辺の重みを変えた最短距離への質問から、未知の二頂点を見つける
metadata.summary: 距離が初めて増える辺を探し、その両側で候補を絞る。基準距離を保つ二つの木を使い、一般の無向グラフでも50回以内の質問で二頂点を特定する。

reference.title: 高速道路の通行料金 (Highway Tolls)
reference.evidence: 既知の単純連結無向グラフで全辺に既知A/Bの二重みを割り当て、固定した未知二点間の最短距離だけを質問する。全A基準を初めて壊す辺prefixを二分して最短路上の辺を得る。その両端への厳密近接集合をBFS木に制限すると、基準距離の道が一意になり、親が先の頂点順のsuffix親辺を重くする質問で二端点を二分できる。整数の丸上げ込みで原典全域50質問以下。
reference.verificationNotes: 2026-10-15に主催原典/公式Reviewと後年Tomasz Idziaszek本人の補足を再読。公式配布HKG/AUT検索本文でN2..90000,M1..130000,1<=A<B<=1e9,単純連結無向/相異なる固定非適応二点/硬制限100回/満点50回を再確認、画像閲覧とは主張しない。公式Reviewの数式欠落は独立証明として区別。pivotは元の少なくとも一本の最短路上で、全元最短路共通とはしない。厳密近接集合の最短路閉性、二BFS木+辺の基準距離保存と一意性、任意A<Bでの等号、祖先先行suffixの判定、ceil log二集合合計32以下を証明。実MDX単一可視完全C++20を抽出、全N2..6連結単純グラフ27475×全pair×5重み=2040405ケース、3000乱択、最大N90000/M130000の6例で毎actual weightingを独立Dijkstraと照合。通常/ASan+UBSanとも178526522 checks,checksum13151808493442697981。実測50質問達成、最大観測距離89998999955001。通常2.16348秒/26248KiB、san33.7653秒/845664KiB。日付2018-09-05はJP公式日別一覧、難度null。

problemFeature.title: 高速道路の通行料金 (Highway Tolls)
features: 既知の単純連結無向グラフに相異なる未知二頂点があり、全質問で固定される。各辺の重みを既知正整数A<Bのどちらかへ自由に設定できる。
質問はその割当での未知二点間の正確な最短距離を返す。二端点を順不同で特定し、複数最短路や任意A<Bを扱う。
problemFeature.notes: 既知の単純連結無向グラフで全辺に既知A/Bの二重みを割り当て、固定した未知二点間の最短距離だけを質問する。全A基準を初めて壊す辺prefixを二分して最短路上の辺を得る。その両端への厳密近接集合をBFS木に制限すると、基準距離の道が一意になり、親が先の頂点順のsuffix親辺を重くする質問で二端点を二分できる。整数の丸上げ込みで原典全域50質問以下。

sourceVerification.officialReviewProvenance: JP委員会公式Tasksの当該課題が解説(英語版)として直接リンクする当時の公式Review。
sourceVerification.officialReviewLimitation: 通常web抽出で数式や定数が一部欠ける。一般解のSolutionBとして、最短路上の辺、その両端への厳密近接集合、二BFS木への制限と二分探索の方針は読める。欠けた式の完全転記や画像の目視は主張せず、各補題と50回上界を独立に証明した。

subsequentSolutionReview.notes: pivotは直前prefixを避ける全A最短路に含まれ、元の少なくとも一本の最短路上にある。元の全最短路共通とはしない。二厳密近接集合の親閉性・二木で距離保存・A道一意性・祖先先行suffix端点探索・任意A<Bでの厳密等号・全N/Mの50回を独立証明した。可視完全C++20の全小グラフ/全pair/5重みと最大を毎質問Dijkstraで検証、通常/ASan+UBSanとも178526522checks/checksum13151808493442697981に一致。初回固定auditを書き換えず、後続resolutionとして登録可能。

api.function: template<SignedDistanceOracle Ask> BinaryWeightHiddenPair find_binary_weight_hidden_pair(int n,const std::vector<int>& from,const std::vector<int>& to,std::int64_t low,std::int64_t high,Ask&& ask)
api.input: 2<=N<=90000,1<=M<=130000,from/to same sizeM,0<=vertices<N,no loops or duplicate unordered pair,connected;1<=low<high<=1e9
api.callback: Invoke named callback as lvalue without copying, with const vector<int>& of lengthM in ORIGINAL edge order, every element0/1; return exact fixed S/T shortest distance as a signed integral type<=64bits with sufficient range. int64 callback includes entire original range.
api.callbackLifetime: Weight array is borrowed only for invocation; retaining its reference/pointer after return or modifying via const_cast is outside contract. Copy bits if persistence is required.
api.hiddenPairContract: The SAME two distinct in-range endpoints are used for ALL responses; nonadaptive. Honesty/consistency are semantic preconditions, not fully decidable by the inexpensive partial checks.
api.result: BinaryWeightHiddenPair{first,second,queries}, first/second is unordered hidden pair,queries counts actual successful-return invocation attempts and is<=50
api.originalAdapter: Caller adapts official ask to callback, then invokes original answer(result.first,result.second) exactly once. Core function itself has no answer side effect.
api.initializationErrors: std::invalid_argument for any invalid graph/limits/tolls before FIRST callback. Includes disconnected graph after independent BFS and duplicate reversal normalization.
api.responseErrors: std::runtime_error for all-low response belowA/above(N−1)A/notdivisiblebyA; later response<baseline or>(baseline/A)B; final recovered candidate unweighted distance inconsistent with baseline. These checks are deliberately incomplete against arbitrary forged/adaptive transcripts.
api.internalBound: std::logic_error before any attempted51st query; independent bound shows unreachable under graph limits, regardless of branch choices
api.callbackExceptions: propagated unchanged, no retries; query attempts or callback side effects already performed are not rolled back
api.allocationErrors: standard allocation exceptions propagate; local temporaries are destroyed, input untouched; failure after a query still consumes that external query
api.state: all graph, BFS, weight, counters, answer state are local per call; noncopyable/stateful callbacks supported; reentrant calls tested; no persistent global state
integerSafety: N<=90000,M<=130000 validated before conversion; INT_MIN/INT_MAX N short-circuit before n−1 expression is evaluated. M cast only after bounds.
CSR offset/cursor/arc indices<=2M<=260000, rank/dist<=N−1<=89999. int static_assert max>=1000000 covers indices and midpoints.
All edge endpoints validated before indexing. Duplicate sort uses copied integer endpoint pairs and never reorders original edge IDs.
Original hop distance d1..N−1. Max shortest toll<=(N−1)B<=89999000000000, and all products explicitly start in int64. No floating comparison or d*(B−A) difference inference.
Prefix binary mid<=M−2 while loop runs, so heavy range endpoint mid+1<=M−1 is valid. Endpoint suffix beginsmid+1>=1, never accesses root parent−1.
Each candidate set nonempty with its root and shortest-path-closed; groups disjoint, every selected nonroot has assigned parent_edge. Final distance BFS sees connected original graph.
Query cap50,countersint; ceil-log proof uses only positive candidate sizes. No recursion or dangerous shifts in published algorithm.
api.time: O((N+M)log(N+M)) local work including validation sort and all bit-vector construction; O(logM+logN) oracle calls, at most50 at full source limits
api.space: O(N+M), excludes callback-owned data/internal distance computation and caller input arrays

proof.exactBaselinePredicate: With minimum hop distance d, every path has>=d edges of weight>=A. A reply equals dA iff an ALL-A path of exactlyd edges survives; any B-edge forces strict increase for EVERY A<B, independently of parity or ratio.
proof.pivot: Increasing prefix heavy edges removes surviving all-A d-hop paths monotonically. k0 false,kM true without querying extremes. At first truek, before adding edgee=k−1 there exists a surviving original shortest path; every such survivor contains e. Thus e belongs to AT LEAST ONE original shortest path, NOT necessarily all original shortest paths.
proof.nearSets: Orient a chosen shortest path S..u−v..T. Its subpaths shortest implydv(S)=du(S)+1 anddu(T)=dv(T)+1. Thus hidden endpoints lie in disjoint strict-nearer sets U/V; tie-distance vertices can be discarded.
proof.parentClosure: Forx inU,dv(x)=du(x)+1 since u/v adjacent. Any full-graph u-geodesic parentp hasdu(p)=du(x)−1 anddv(p)>=dv(x)−1=du(x)>du(p); hencep inU. Induced BFS retains global du. SameforV.
proof.twoTreeRestriction: Chosen BFS trees are disjoint and pivot connects roots. Their S−T path has lengthdu(S)+1+dv(T)=d. AssignB outside them andA inside, retaining baseline. The all-A graph contains one tree onU∪V plus isolated ties, so baseline-preserving S−T path is unique.
proof.suffixPredicate: In parent-before-child order, every root-tox ancestor has smallerindex thanx. Heavy parentedges of childrenindex>mid intersect root-tox path iffindex(x)>mid, because x's own parentedge witnesses the forward direction. Other tree and pivot remainA. Rootindex0 naturally has no parentedge and is handled without special queries.
proof.queryBound: Baseline1+ceil_log2(M)+ceil_log2(p)+ceil_log2(q). M<=130000 gives17. p+q<=90000,p/q>=1; ceil logs sum>=33 requires at least32769+65537=98306 vertices, so sum<=32. Hence<=50, exact achievable example tested.
proof.complexity: Three initial BFS traversals (connectivity plus both roots), two induced BFS trees, final candidate BFS, validation sort, and O(logM+logN) O(N+M) weighting builds give O((N+M)log(N+M)) local time,O(N+M) memory. Oracle internals excluded.

verification.oracle: For EVERY algorithm-generated actual weighting in each valid solve case, build no assumed tree: run ordinary priority-queue Dijkstra over the ORIGINAL undirected graph with each original edge cost chosen directly from actual0/1 bit and A/B. Hidden S/T are immutable const fields for the entire run. Verify returned unordered pair, observed/reported call count,<=50 before each distance call, exact M binary terminals, unchanged original edge arrays.

Total27475 graphs/2040405 cases. Does not use solver BFS trees or suffix tests as oracle.

editorNotes: Eight Japanese technique sections and one always-visible complete C++20 template callback API; no perproblem page.
Article contains mathematical model,proofs,API,complexity,implementation and references; retrieval history/counts/benchmark data remain sidecar-only.

OfficialReview and later Tomasz Idziaszek supplement remain distinct; ref/feature/subsequent review independent-analysis, difficulty null, date2018-09-05 verified by JP official competition-day index.
Initial fixed audit/ledger/shared flow were not edited. Parent can preserve initial other→generalinteractive steps while adding later concrete article/branch/reference/feature resolution.
The method requires no primal tree assumption, no unique original shortest path, no A/B parity condition and no large B/A ratio; uniqueness is deliberately created by twoBFS-tree restriction.

Partial malformed-response checks are NOT a semantic proof against arbitrary inconsistent/adaptive oracle. Exact fixed-pair response is an explicit contract, and exceptions cannot roll back external queries.

independentReview.notes: 主催者配布の原典/Review/翻訳検索の数値を区別して全scopeを確認。全本文と掲載API/最悪予算を独立精読し、通常とASan/UBSanで全件数・checksum・コードSHAを再現。既に確認済みの初回研究へ重複reviewを付加せず、完成実装と証明は研究記録とresolutionへ保存。
